title: Implementation substantially exceeds the spec (15 MCP tools)
evidence: src/brsoccer_tools.erl:25-93 registers search_matches, head_to_head, team_stats, standings, competition_bracket, competition_stats, compare_seasons, biggest_wins, team_rankings, team_competitions, derbies, search_players, player_details, brazilian_clubs_players, dataset_summary
suggestion: None — noted as capability beyond the required checklist, not a deduction.

title: Cross-file duplicate detection and season inference beyond spec
evidence: src/brsoccer_data.erl:230-261 finish/1 flags same-match duplicates across the overlapping Serie A files (±2 days) so a season yields exactly 380 unique matches; test/brsoccer_tests.erl:111-113 pins this

title: Hardcoded foreign-namesake blocklist in Brazilian club summary
evidence: src/brsoccer_query.erl:460-461 brazil_club_guard/1 excludes exactly ["Boavista FC", "Sport Club", "Guaraní"] by literal name
suggestion: Functional but brittle; a data-driven guard (e.g. nationality majority already used at line 456) would generalise.

title: Relegation count hardcoded by season heuristic in standings tool
evidence: src/brsoccer_tools.erl:177 `Releg = if Comp =/= serie_a; not Complete -> 0; Season =:= 2003 -> 2; true -> 4`
suggestion: Domain-reasonable (2003 had 2 relegated, later seasons 4) but magic numbers; a per-season config would be clearer. No behavioural defect.
